correctness.rationale: The 2025 primary paper gives, for the same discretely represented class, the explicit projection \(P\) onto \(c_{0,\mathcal I}\) and states \(\|P\|\le2\). The 2026 follow-up reports the universal lower bound \(2\) for the complementation constant of every proper complemented ideal. Sandwiching those bounds forces the exact constant and the canonical \(P\)-norm to be \(2\). For \(Q=I-P\), the block formula is contractive because every ultrafilter limit has norm one and the blocks partition the coordinates; \(Q\mathbf1=\mathbf1\) forces \(\|Q\|=1\).
